list.title: Your events
list.emptyBody: Pick a format, add your prizes and publish. Your members see it in the POWR app, the leaderboard runs itself, and you reveal the winners from here. POWR checks your first event before it goes out.

detail.runByPowrAtGym: Run by POWR at your gym
detail.runByPowrBody: POWR wrote it, sends the notifications and reveals the results. You can see who’s in, follow the board, and put it on your TV.

toast.published: Published — members can see it now
toast.sentForCheck: Sent to POWR for a quick check

confirm.reveal: Reveal the winners of {{event}}? Everyone in it gets a notification and your screen flips at the same moment.
confirm.cancel: Cancel {{event}}? It disappears from the app for everyone who can see it.
confirm.cancelJoined_one: Cancel {{event}}? It disappears from the app for everyone who can see it, including the {{count}} who joined.
confirm.cancelJoined_other: Cancel {{event}}? It disappears from the app for everyone who can see it, including the {{count}} who joined.

remove.body: They drop off the board of {{event}} and their points in it no longer count. Their POWR account isn’t touched, and you can put them back. POWR sees the reason.
remove.placeholder: e.g. Logged sessions they didn’t do

print.title: {{event}} · join
print.scan: Scan to join in the POWR app

next.draftBody: Only your team can see it, in the POWR app too, if you want to check how it looks.
next.draftTrusted: Publishing puts it in front of your members straight away.
next.draftCheck: Your first event gets a quick check from POWR before it goes out.
next.pendingBody: We'll approve it or tell you what to change, usually within a day. Pull it back if you need to edit.
next.rejectedBody: Edit it and send it again.
next.scheduledBody: Members can see it and join now. Scoring starts {{day}}.
next.liveBody: Scoring until the end of {{day}}. The board seals after that.
next.liveBodyFinale: Scoring until the end of {{day}}. The board seals after that, and you reveal it at the finale night ({{finale}}).
next.lockedBody: Reveal the winners when you're ready — the app and your screen flip together.
next.lockedAuto: If nobody does, POWR reveals it {{when}}.
next.revealedBody: Revealed {{when}}. Winners show their POWR ID at the front desk to collect their prize; tick each one off under Details.
next.codes_one: {{n}} person has a {{brand}} code in their Wallet.
next.codes_other: {{n}} people have a {{brand}} code in their Wallet.
next.codesPartner_one: {{n}} person has a partner code in their Wallet.
next.codesPartner_other: {{n}} people have a partner code in their Wallet.
next.settledBody: Thanks for running it. The same set-up is one click away.
next.cancelledBody: It no longer shows in the app.
next.pulledBody: Get in touch if you have questions.

board.teamOnly: Only your team sees this until you reveal
board.notYet: The board appears once the event is published.

people.title: Who’s in · {{n}}
people.empty: Nobody’s joined yet. Share the link under Promote with your members.
people.guestNote: A guest joined without having picked {{gym}} as their gym in the app: worth a word at the front desk.

details.title: Details
details.bonusPaid: +{{points}} POWR for everyone who comes · paid
details.audienceRadius: Your members and recent visitors, plus anyone within {{km}} km
details.headline: Headline
details.prizesTick: Prizes · tick each one when it’s handed over
details.codesLater: For everyone who scores, in their Wallet when you reveal the winners
details.codesLaterLeft_one: For everyone who scores, in their Wallet when you reveal the winners · {{n}} code left
details.codesLaterLeft_other: For everyone who scores, in their Wallet when you reveal the winners · {{n}} codes left

promote.explainer: The TV board counts down, shows the live standings, holds a sealed screen once the board seals, then plays the podium the moment you reveal. The share page and the QR open the event in the POWR app, or the app store for someone new.
promote.print: Print it for the front desk
promote.draftNote: The TV board, the share page and the join QR appear here once the event is published.

door.title: The door
door.intro: Doors {{day}}, {{time}}. POWR sees most people arrive and pays them itself once the doors close. Check in anyone it missed, and they get the bonus now.
door.introDone: Doors {{day}}, {{time}}. POWR sees most people arrive and pays them itself (done). Check in anyone it missed, and they get the bonus now.
door.closedNote: The door opens two hours before the finale and closes six hours after. Until then this is the guest list.
door.findPlaceholder: Find someone by name or POWR ID
door.confirm: Check {{name}} in? They get +{{points}} POWR now.
door.capReached: That’s the limit for check-ins by hand tonight. Ask POWR if more people are here.

pushes.title: Notifications
pushes.intro: POWR writes them and sends them at the right moment; you choose which go out. Members can turn notifications off in the app.
pushes.introDraft: Nothing goes out until the event is published.
pushes.introOver: The event is over, so here’s what went out.
pushes.audience: Your members and recent visitors who haven’t joined: {{people}} right now, {{reachable}} with notifications on.
pushes.audienceNone: Nobody yet. It goes to members who pick {{gym}} as their gym and anyone who’s trained there in the last 60 days.
pushes.joined: Everyone who’s joined: {{people}} so far, {{reachable}} with notifications on.
pushes.announceWhen: Sent once, in the daytime, at least 30 minutes after the event is published.
pushes.doorsWhen: Sent the morning of the finale.
pushes.standingsDetail: Each member gets their own rank and points, and how far they are from the place above. Only while the board is live, never once it’s sealed.
pushes.lastSentTeam: Last sent {{when}} to {{people}}, by your team
pushes.confirmSend: Send today’s standings to {{people}} now? You can do this once a day, and the scheduled one still goes out.

phases.beforeBlurb: Announce it: a ticket with the join QR, three looks over your lead photo, a teaser over every other photo, and an A4 poster for the front desk.
phases.afterBlurb: Wrap it up: the results once the winners are out, a thank-you over your lead photo, and a branded recap of every photo from the night.

looks.mixedBlurb: film and colour, post by post
looks.filmBlurb: black and white, the house look

accents.powrBlurb: white type, gold for the key word
accents.varyBlurb: POWR gold and gold headlines, alternating

content.lockedBody: Clash Pro turns your photos and clips into every post you need before and after an event, at every size, in one download.
